notes: The PDF shown has no inventory pages, so Element IDs are best guesses from the pictures. Catalogue types were chosen by shape and colour, and four new generic types were added (hard hat, bucket, roll bar, beacon).
Steps 2 to 9 are small pictures. The exact pieces and stud positions of the yellow plates, black slopes and grille pieces are approximate.
The two dark gray wheel holders are shown upside down in steps 8 and 9. They are modelled as attached to the underside of the black 2x6 base plate.
The minifig torso is shown as an orange vest with blue arms. It is mapped to the catalogue blue torso as the closest match.
The step 9 and 10 arm extension, the bucket clip joint and the seat and roll-bar positions are inferred from the final picture in step 11.
The model has no electrical parts, so there are no electrical edges.
